Class GameService

java.lang.Object
com.barbu.api.game.GameService
@Service public class GameService extends Object
Orchestrator for all game operations.

No mutable game state is stored in the database, only the ordered list of GameMoveEntity rows. Current state is reconstructed by replaying those moves via GameState.replay(GameSettings, long, List).

The methods (applyMove, startGame and leaveGame) use TransactionTemplate rather than @Transactional so that each move (human or bot) is committed and broadcast independently.

  • Method Details

    • createGame

      @Transactional public UUID createGame(String variantId, String creatorUsername, BotType botDifficulty)
      Creates a new game for creatorUsername using the given variant.
      Parameters:
      botDifficulty - the bot type used for all bot additions in this game: fill-with-bots before start, and seat replacements when a human leaves mid-game. Defaults to BotType.MEDIUM if null.
      Returns:
      the new game's ID

    • joinGame

      @Transactional public void joinGame(UUID gameId, String username)
      Adds username to the game's lobby. Throws if the user is already in another active game, the game is full, or is no longer accepting players.

    • leaveGame

      public Optional<LobbyEventDTO> leaveGame(UUID gameId, String username, Consumer<GameUpdateBundle> onGameUpdateBundle)
      Removes username from the game and handles the effects.
      • Lobby: player is removed; if no humans remain, the game is abandoned.
      • In-progress: the seat is immediately filled by a bot; if no humans remain the game is abandoned, otherwise bot turns run after the transaction commits.

    • findActiveGame

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public Optional<UUID> findActiveGame(String username)
      Returns the ID of the active game username is currently seated in, if any. Used by the frontend on page load to reconnect a user to their ongoing game.

    • applyMove

      public void applyMove(UUID gameId, IncomingMoveDTO incomingMoveDTO, String username, Consumer<GameUpdateBundle> onGameUpdateBundle)
      Validates and persists a human move, then drives any consecutive bot turns. Throws IllegalMoveException (rolls back the transaction) if the move is illegal.
      Parameters:
      onGameUpdateBundle - called outside the DB transaction for each broadcast snapshot

    • startGame

      public void startGame(UUID gameId, String username, Consumer<GameUpdateBundle> onGameUpdateBundle)
      Transitions the game from WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS to IN_PROGRESS, then drives any bot turns that open. Requires the game to have exactly 4 players seated.
      Parameters:
      onGameUpdateBundle - called outside the DB transaction for each state snapshot to broadcast: first the initial game state, then any opening bot moves

    • fillWithBots

      @Transactional public LobbyEventDTO fillWithBots(UUID gameId, String username)
      Fills any empty seats with bots using the game's configured default bot type. The calling user must already be seated in the game. Returns the updated lobby state for broadcasting.

    • getGameUpdate

      @Nullable @Transactional(readOnly=true) public PublicGameUpdateDTO getGameUpdate(UUID gameId)
      Returns the current public game state for subscription snapshots. Returns null if the game has not started yet or was abandoned before starting.

    • getPrivatePlayerState

      @Nullable @Transactional(readOnly=true) public PrivatePlayerStateDTO getPrivatePlayerState(UUID gameId, String username)
      Returns the private state (hand + legal moves) for username in the given game. Returns null if the game has not started yet.
